direct.new:
§3301. Rate of tax

There is hereby imposed on every employer (as defined in section 3306(a)) for each calendar year an excise tax, with respect to having individuals in his employ, equal to 6 percent of the total wages (with no exemptions) paid by such employer during the calendar year with respect to employment (as defined in section 3306(c)).
